accessibility.calendar: Theme-specific 3D SVGs, a 2D SVG alternative, normalized CSV and textual summary
accessibility.interactive_visuals: GitHub README embeds are static; genuinely interactive views use external links
accessibility.projects: Theme-specific desktop and mobile SVGs, linked Markdown text alternative and JSON source snapshot

refresh.failure_behaviour: Generation or validation failure leaves the portfolio-assets branch unchanged. The last valid files remain available, their visible data-through date ages, and the workflow status reports the failure.
refresh.last_successful_refresh: For an Actions run, use that run's timestamp. Execution time is kept outside the deterministic bundle.
refresh.recovery: Inspect the failed refresh run, correct the source or validator, then retry through workflow_dispatch. Publication follows only after complete generation and hash validation.
refresh.workflow_mode: Default-branch GitHub Actions schedule, push or dispatch; validated assets publish to portfolio-assets; no application deployment.

github_public_contributions.authentication: Job-scoped GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:read; no read:user scope or personal access token.
github_public_contributions.metric: Daily contribution counts as returned by GitHub for the approved public profile.
github_public_contributions.scope: Public contribution calendar; the query requests no private or restricted-contribution fields and the workflow token has no read:user permission.

product_screenshots.cadence: Refresh only after a material product change and review
product_screenshots.source_policy: Any added capture must reference a human-reviewed immutable product revision
product_screenshots.state: No product screenshot is included in this generated bundle

animation.alt_text: Isometric daily commit calendar from 2025-11-03 to 2026-11-02: 196 commits across 30 active days and 365 dated days, including zero-count days.
animation.format: finite GIF, eight frames, no infinite-loop extension

public_commits.authentication: Read-only GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN with contents:read, sent only to api.github.com for the reviewed owner/repository allowlist; no read:user scope or personal access token.
public_commits.metric: Distinct commit objects linked to the profile in selected public default branches, bucketed by author timestamp in UTC.
